name: Jezero Crater - Western Delta (PRIMARY)
science_goal: Study delta deposits and sampled rocks along a planned Marswalk

layers.name: Elevation / Slope
layers.limitation: 20 m cells; landforms smaller than 20 m unresolved; east strip lon > 77.699 and south strip lat < 18.211 are DERIVED edge-fill, flagged in provenance mask. (The 20 km region box sits fully inside CTX coverage, so no edge-fill cells fall inside it.)

layers.name: Surface imagery
layers.limitation: Orbital picture, not a live view. Lighting/season differ from other layers.

layers.name: Carbonate (zone-mapped rover composition)
layers.product: Zone-mapped carbonate wt% (Clavé et al. 2026; Science 2026 PIXL supplement)
layers.acquired: rover sols 1-286 (SuperCam) and Margin Unit campaign
layers.limitation: Zone-mapped rover composition (wt%), not a spectrometer map: each zone shows the midpoint of its published carbonate range (Z1 <5 wt%, Z2 3-9 wt%, Z3 6-16 wt%), stored as wt%/20. Zones with no published carbonate (Z4/Z5/Z6) have no coverage. The CRISM spectral index (0-0.11) is not wt% and was not used.

warnings: Chemical layer is zone-mapped from published rover composition ranges, not a per-pixel spectrometer map; boundaries are approximate zone polygons.
Output grid is 50 m, resampled (bilinear) from the 20 m CTX DTM: detail finer than 50 m is interpolated, not real; the source resolution stays 20 m.
